##### Project general facts

Al Maryah Vista is a residential development presented as the first residential building of its kind within its waterfront community, the project offers an exquisite collection of premium homes together with a limited number of one-of-a-kind duplex penthouses framed by panoramic skyline and waterfront views. The architectural design follows a consistent, forward-looking approach, with attention to exterior finishing and balcony detailing carried across the building's contemporary silhouette.

Residents have access to a swimming pool and a dedicated kids' swimming pool, a gymnasium equipped with premium quality equipment, landscaped gardens, on-site retail areas, covered parking and six large elevators serving the building. The development also sits beside a swimmable canal pool along the waterfront promenade, adding to the everyday outdoor lifestyle available to residents.

Units include kitchen cabinets and countertops fitted with a refrigerator, washing machine and cooker, wardrobes in the bedrooms, and fully tiled bathrooms, en-suites and guest toilets with marble and ceramic flooring throughout. Homes are centrally air conditioned and provide a satellite master antenna connection, fibre-optic high-speed internet provision and double-glazed windows. The residences are kitchen-equipped only.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the prime waterfront location of pedestrian-friendly Al Maryah Island, this exceptional location puts residents right in the heart of the city's new luxury neighbourhood. Al Maryah Island is where diversity and innovation come together, home to Abu Dhabi's International Financial Centre, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and Al Maryah Central, the city's largest shopping centre. Residents enjoy world-class shopping and dining, exceptional healthcare, and a harmonious waterside living.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to the best things to see and do in the UAE's capital, from Louvre Abu Dhabi to the nearby Galleria and Abu Dhabi Global Market to the golden shores of Saadiyat Beach. The island's strategic positioning offers a seamless blend of cultural richness, commercial vitality, and natural beauty.

For those seeking a residence that embodies legendary service, refined luxury, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Al Maryah Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — sophisticated, connected and effortlessly elegant.
